prompt:
We've been accumulating hard-won lessons from our bioinformatics pipeline failures all quarter and it's time to formalize them. I need you to:

1. Set up the persistent knowledge management system in this workspace (the scripts are already here).

2. Our raw notes are in `research_findings.md` — convert the relevant findings into properly structured entries in the system. Pay close attention to which findings have enough proven history to be formalized.

3. Run the full weekly maintenance cycle: this includes the confidence adjustment process and the step that elevates proven findings into hard policies.

4. Our partners at Nexigen Genomics need our config-related policies only. Generate a shareable policy export file called `partner-export.json` in the workspace root containing only our configuration policies.

The system should be fully operational after you're done.
